lead: The most creative and cosmopolitan neighbourhood in Valencia: art galleries, design bars, world cuisine and the energy of a neighbourhood that never stops. A 10-minute walk from everything.

The accommodation on offer in Ruzafa perfectly reflects the personality of the neighbourhood: there are no big hotel chains. Instead, you will find the neighbourhood’s only boutique hotel in a 19th-century building, an intimate 6-room B&B with a terrace and homemade breakfast, and a collection of apartments with kitchens in the most emblematic building of SingularStays.

Ruzafa is the ideal choice for travellers who want to experience Valencia from the inside: having breakfast on a B&B terrace, going to the market for fruit, discovering an art gallery around the corner and dining at one of the most interesting restaurants in the city without needing to take the metro.

items.title: Petit Palace Ruzafa
items.subtitle: The only hotel in Ruzafa · Pet friendly · Free bikes · 19th-century façade · 10 min from the AVE station
items.body: The Petit Palace Ruzafa is the only hotel in the strict sense in the Ruzafa neighbourhood, and one of the best-loved boutique accommodations in Valencia. It occupies a lovely building with a 19th-century façade on Carrer de Sueca, in the very heart of the city’s most creative neighbourhood. Its 41 rooms — double, triple, quadruple and with terrace — are designed in a modern, functional style, with WiFi, satellite LCD TV, safe and minibar. The hotel lends bicycles completely free of charge to explore Ruzafa and the Turia Gardens. The buffet breakfast is one of the most highly rated in the neighbourhood. Reception is open 24 hours, and Sunday and Monday check-out is extended to 15:00 at no extra cost. It is pet friendly at no extra charge when booking on the official website. The Joaquín Sorolla AVE station is only a 10-minute walk away.

items.title: City Garden Bed & Breakfast
items.subtitle: 6 intimate rooms · Private terrace · Breakfast included · Authentic local atmosphere · Since 2017
items.body: The City Garden Bed & Breakfast is the most distinctive accommodation in Ruzafa: a small, well-kept B&B of only 6 rooms located on a quiet pedestrian street in the neighbourhood, open since 2017. Each room has a private bathroom, air conditioning, Smart TV and WiFi, with simple, welcoming decor full of little details. The jewel of the property is its large outdoor terrace — shaded by a pergola — where breakfast is served in the mornings and where guests can relax at any hour. Coffee and tea are available 24 hours in the common area. Among the rooms, the Ruzafa Suite (for 4 people) stands out, the room with views of the traditional square with its tiled fountain, and the bright Sunny Room with a large window onto the garden. It is the ideal place for quiet travellers who want to live Ruzafa like a local. A 10-minute walk from the Plaza del Ayuntamiento.

items.title: SingularStays Parque Central
items.subtitle: 38 m² lofts and studios · Up to 4 guests · Equipped kitchen · Interior patio · Free bike parking
items.body: SingularStays Parque Central is a collection of modern, fully equipped tourist apartments in the heart of Ruzafa, in the company’s flagship building next to Valencia’s Parque Central. The lofts — of about 38 m² — have a double bed and a double sofa bed for up to 4 guests, a full open kitchen (hob, fridge, microwave, coffee machine, kettle, crockery), a private bathroom with shower, centralised air conditioning and Smart TV with WiFi. The façade of the building, historic in style and lit at night, contrasts with a completely modern interior that includes an interior patio with greenery and relaxation areas. Reception is open Monday to Friday from 10:00 to 18:00; outside those hours there is self check-in. Free bike parking with a workshop area included. A 5-minute walk from the Estación del Nord and the Mercat de Russafa.

blocks.title: Tips for staying in Ruzafa
items: The Petit Palace Ruzafa lends bikes for free — the best way to ride along the Turia Gardens and reach the City of Arts in 20 minutes
The City Garden B&B is perfect for quiet travellers seeking an intimate atmosphere: only 6 rooms and breakfast on the terrace. Book in advance, it fills up fast
The SingularStays are ideal for groups or families who want to cook and live like a local: the Mercat de Russafa is 5 minutes away

The neighbourhood has plenty of nightlife: on Fridays and Saturdays there can be noise until late. All the accommodations are well soundproofed, but an interior room is recommended if you are sensitive to noise
The Mercat de Russafa (on the very street of the Petit Palace) is an essential visit — fruit, spices, artisan products and the best market atmosphere in the neighbourhood
From Ruzafa you reach the historic centre on foot in 10–15 minutes along the calle Xàtiva or the Paseo de la Alameda — you need no transport at all
